decision_conditions: Your application was refused because the felling of T1 Alder as no substantive evidence has been provided to demonstrate that the tree is causing, or is reasonably likely to cause, structural damage to the adjacent wall. The justification relies on unsubstantiated concerns regarding potential future movement, with no supporting engineering assessment, structural survey, or arboricultural evidence to confirm rootrelated impact or instability. In the absence of such information, the removal of a TPO protected tree would result in an unjustified loss of public amenity. The proposal therefore fails to demonstrate a need for removal and cannot be supported.
description: T1. Fell Alder directly adjacent to wall to ground level to prevent potential wall collapse as a result of incremental secondary thickening and root growth.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
